description: This file implements the URL class in the WPEFramework namespace, providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and conversion functionalities, including handling of schemes, domain, user info, path, query, and fragment components.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a parsed URL, including scheme, user info, host, port, path, query, and reference components.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components.

methods.name: ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain and port from a URL fragment.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Constructs the full URL string from its components.

methods.name: uint16_t Encode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-safe string.

methods.name: uint16_t Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string into the original.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Encode(const uint8_t * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const bool padding)
methods.description: Encodes binary data using Base64 for URL safety.

methods.name: uint16_t Base64Decode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,uint8_t * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength,const TCHAR * ignoreList)
methods.description: Decodes Base64 URL-safe data into binary.

methods.name: uint32_t CopyFragment(TCHAR * destination,const uint32_t maxLength,uint32_t index,const string & data)
uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
